Card Q&A.a: No, the time to trigger [When Attacking] effects has already passed, so the effect doesn't activate.
Card Q&A.q: I digivolve using this card’s [When Attacking] effect. If the Digimon I digivolve into has a [When Attacking] effect, does that effect activate?

Card Q&A.a: The attack continues. The turn doesn’t switch over until the attack has ended.
Card Q&A.q: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, paying the digivolution cost moves the memory gauge to 1 or more on my opponent’s side. What happens to the attack?

Effect: [When Attacking] This Digimon can digivolve into a Digimon card with [Insectoid] in its traits in your hand for its digivolution cost.
